title: Login: a hung "Sign in with SSO" request spins forever; the 20 s sign-in watchdog does not cover the SSO-by-email path
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

## What happens
If `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso` never answers, the login page shows a spinner forever with the email field disabled. The 20 s sign-in watchdog (#2626) never fires on this path.

## Reproduction
Reproduced twice at `6091b645`.
1. Boot with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true`.
2. Register one OIDC provider (`qa-fixture oidc-stub`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register`).
3. Open `/_console/login` in a fresh browser and make `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso` never answer (a Playwright `page.route` that never fulfils).
4. Type an email and click "Sign in with SSO".
- Expected: after about 20 s the watchdog recovers the button with an error and a retry path.
- Actual: at 22 s and at 32 s the button is still spinning and the email field is still disabled.

## Mechanism
The SSO submit in `ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` (around line 541) is a bare `fetch('/api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso', …)` with no timeout. The watchdog (`SIGN_IN_TIMEOUT_MS` / `withTimeout`) wraps only `signInWithProvider` in `createAuthClient.ts`. Fix: send the SSO submit through the same 20 s AbortController watchdog.
